jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Garage
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 3 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a technology or a business related field.
* Experience in designing AI interfaces that handle latency and failures gracefully, with preferred experience in HR product management.
* Ability to design quantitative frameworks that track real\-time model performance, grounding accuracy, system degradation, and hallucination rates.
* Ability to lead complex, ambiguous technical initiatives and aligning high\-profile, cross\-functional teams toward shared goals.
* Deep technical fluency in generative AI mechanics.

**About the job**
-----------------


At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  

  

In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  

  

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  


The People Operations (POps) Engineering team within Core at Google is dedicated to building innovative and scalable technology solutions that empower Google's global workforce. We leverage the power of data and Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) to optimize Human Resource (HR) processes, enhance employee experiences, and drive organizational efficiency.
  

  

In this role, you will be instrumental in shaping, defining, and delivering AI\-powered agentic products that will transform how our HR function operates and enhances the employee experience.


At Corp Eng, we build world\-leading business solutions that scale a more helpful Google for everyone. As Google’s IT organization, we provide end\-to\-end solutions for organizations across Google. We deliver the right tools, platforms, and experiences for all Googlers as they create more helpful products and services for everyone. In the simplest terms, we are Google for Googlers.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define the multi\-year AI\-native product goal and technical strategy, mapping rapidly evolving foundational models to consumer breakthroughs that achieve sustainable product\-market fit.
* Write comprehensive Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) accounting for non\-deterministic software behavior, establishing explicit guidelines for system instructions, fine\-tuning, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) ingestion pipelines, and safety classifiers.
* Partner with Google researchers and infrastructure engineers to co\-design model requirements, optimizing latency, context windows, compute budgets, and token utilization.
* Pioneer innovative frameworks for multi\-agent execution, asynchronous system tracking, and human\-in\-the\-loop validation to deliver contextual, ambient, and non\-chatbot intelligence.
* Implement robust Large Language Models (LLM) evaluation systems tracking factual alignment while leading cross\-functional alignment with Trust, Safety, Legal, and global Policy teams.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Reputation**


Reputation, founded in Silicon Valley in 2013, is the industry's sole platform that uses an AI\-powered product stack to help companies measure, manage, and scale their real\-time reputation performance everywhere, effectively functioning as a business's eyes and ears across all customer feedback channels to uncover predictive insights. This market leadership is reinforced by significant funding from top\-tier firms like Bessemer Venture Partner, Kleiner Perkins, and Marlin Equity Partners, driving substantial annual recurring revenue from Global Fortune 1000 companies, major automotive OEMs, healthcare systems, and top property management firms, with trust from over 250 partners including Google and Meta. Recognized recently as America’s Greatest Midsized Workplaces by Newsweek which rewards excellence and career development, and attracts player\-coaches, team\-oriented collaborators, and individuals who value perseverance and hustle.

**Your Role at Reputation****:**

We are looking for a Product Manager to support our core Reputation Management platform. The ideal candidate will possess a drive and passion for enabling high\-quality customer experiences.  

  

**How You'll Shape the Experience:**

* Articulate business requirements for supported product
* Conduct market research supported by on\-going engagements with customers and non\-customers
* The ideal candidate will be able to provide actionable guidance to Engineering with clear prioritization of development efforts, based on solving customer pain points and well defined success metrics
* Work closely with cross functional teams such as designers, program managers and developers, providing thorough reviews and necessary guidance to iterate over solution designs
* Create and present developer\-facing work products (e.g. taxonomies, navigation, page flows)
* Evangelize the product vision with effective and powerful communication
* Create and present high\-quality customer\-facing deliverables (user stories, designs)
* Focus on data driven decision making
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of your product area — from problem definition through launch and post\-launch iteration — driving outcomes without waiting to be asked
* Additional duties as assigned

**The Skills That Set You Apart:**

* 5\+ years in product management with a track record for launching successful enterprise SaaS products, and managing them over multiple releases
* B.Tech / B.E. / BS / BA in a technical or business field; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is a plus
* Highly articulate with outstanding verbal and written communication skills
* A strong ownership mindset with the drive to push work forward through ambiguity, remove blockers proactively, and consistently get things done
* Experience with data, insights, and reporting products (dashboards, analytics, metrics frameworks) is beneficial
* Exposure to AI/ML\-powered product capabilities and an understanding of how to apply them to real customer problems is beneficial
* Willingness to work in the evenings as needed to collaborate with our US\-based teams and stakeholders.

**Where You’ll Connect \& Collaborate:**

* Your main HQ is our Hyderabad, Telangana office, but we know great work can happen anywhere. You’ll have the flexibility of a hybrid schedule, joining us in person on Tuesdays and Wednesdays (subject to change) and working from home the rest of the week.

 **Our Benefits \& Perks**


We believe our people deserve to feel supported, valued, and rewarded both in and out of work. That’s why we offer a generous and thoughtfully designed benefits package, including:

* **Health Insurance \& Wellness Benefits:** Group Health Insurance: Medical Insurance with floater policy of up to Rs 10,00,000 for employee \+ spouse \+ 2 dependent children \+ 2 parents / parent\-in\-laws
* **Maternity Benefits:** Medical insurance up to 75,000 INR, 26 weeks of leave for birth, adoption or surrogacy
* **Life Insurance:** Insurance at 3x annual cost to the company (Term Insurance, GPA)
* **Accident/Disability Insurance:** Insured at 3x base salary for permanent total disability, permanent partial disability and temporary total disability (GPA)
* **OPD:** As part of your health benefits, Employees are entitled to an annual OPD allowance of ₹7,500\. This can be used for doctor consultations, diagnostic tests, and prescribed medications. The benefit is applicable to both the employee and eligible dependents and should be claimed within a month's time.
* **AHC:** All employees are eligible for one complimentary Annual Health Check each year. Employees may also extend this benefit to their dependents, they can avail the same package at the specially negotiated rates, payable by the employee.

**Leaves**

* **Company Holidays:** 10 paid holidays per year (see annual Holiday Calendar)
* **Casual/Sick Leave:** 12 days per year (pro\-rated)
* **Earned Leave:** 2 days per month (pro\-rated)
* **Extended Company Holidays:** 4 additional paid days off
* **Maternity Leave:** 6 months
* **Paternity Leave:** 10 working days
* **Bereavement Leave:** 10 working days

**Car Lease:**

* Reputation is offering a Car Lease Program that allows employees to lease a car with no upfront cost or down payment. They benefit from a fixed monthly lease rental and 20\-30% tax savings.

*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

*To learn more about how we handle the personal data of applicants, visit our* *Candidate Privacy Notice**.*

*Applicants only \- No 3rd party agency candidates.*

**Manager, Product Management**

**This role is** **Office Based, Hyderabad Office****Manager, Product Management \| HR Technology \| Hyderabad**


Cornerstone OnDemand is a leading global talent management and HR software company that empowers organizations to engage, develop, and retain their workforce. Our innovative solutions help companies of all sizes and industries to achieve their business objectives through effective talent management, learning, and performance management.


**Position Overview**


We are seeking an experienced and strategic Manager of Product Management to join our dynamic team at Cornerstone OnDemand. In this role, you will lead and shape our product strategy, manage a team of product managers, and drive the development and enhancement of our cutting\-edge learning management products. As a Manager, you will work closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure our products align with customer needs and market trends while maintaining Cornerstone's commitment to innovation and excellence.
  

  

**In This Role You Will**


Product Strategy: Develop and execute a comprehensive product strategy that aligns with the company's vision, goals, and market demands.
  

Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and manage a team of product managers, fostering a culture of collaboration and high performance.
  

Product Lifecycle Management: Oversee the entire product development lifecycle, from concept to launch, and beyond, ensuring products are delivered on time and within budget.
  

Market Analysis: Conduct in\-depth market research to identify trends, opportunities, and competitive landscapes, and use this information to drive product innovation.
  

Customer Focus: Act as the voice of the customer, ensuring that products meet and exceed customer expectations while enhancing user experience.
  

Cross\-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with engineering, design, sales, and marketing teams to deliver exceptional products and solutions.
  

Roadmap Planning: Create and maintain product roadmaps, prioritizing features and enhancements based on market needs, business objectives, and customer feedback.
  

Quality Assurance: Ensure the highest quality standards for product delivery, including rigorous testing and quality control processes.
  

Compliance: Stay informed about industry regulations and standards and ensure that our products adhere to all necessary compliance requirements.
  

  

**You Have Got What it takes if you have**


Bachelor's degree in a related field;
  

Proven experience in product management, with a strong track record of successfully launching and managing software products.
  

Demonstrated leadership and team management skills
  

Deep understanding of learning management solutions is a plus.
  

Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to make data\-driven decisions.
  

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and departments.
  

Strategic thinking, with the ability to create and execute a clear product vision.
  

Results\-oriented and committed to meeting and exceeding company objectives.
  

Knowledge of agile development methodologies and product management tools.
  

  

**Why Cornerstone OnDemand**


At Cornerstone OnDemand, we believe in fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment where you can make a real impact on the future of talent management and HR software. You will have the opportunity to work with a passionate team of professionals, access ongoing learning and development, and contribute to a company that is dedicated to helping organizations unleash the potential of their workforce.
  

If you are a strategic thinker with a strong product management background and are excited about the opportunity to shape the future of our industry\-leading solutions, we encourage you to apply for the Director, Product Management position at Cornerstone OnDemand.

  

  

**Our Culture:**


Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.


**Who We Are:**


Cornerstone powers the potential of organizations and their people to thrive in a changing world. Cornerstone Galaxy, the complete AI\-powered workforce agility platform, meets organizations where they are. With Galaxy, organizations can identify skills gaps and development opportunities, retain and engage top talent, and provide multimodal learning experiences to meet the diverse needs of the modern workforce. More than 7,000 organizations and 100 million\+ users in 180\+ countries and in nearly 50 languages use Cornerstone Galaxy to build high\-performing, future\-ready organizations and people today.


Check us out on LinkedIn, Comparably, Glassdoor, and Facebook!

**Location:** Bangalore, Hybrid (3 days onsite, 2 days remote)


**Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP



About the Role


As a Full\-Stack Senior Product Software Engineer, you will collaborate with cross\-functional partners and engineering teams on the design and implementation of innovative products and features, contributing to the evolution of user\-centric advertising at scale. You’ll exercise technical ownership, provide peer mentoring, and ensure our systems are robust, observable, and future\-ready.


On a daily basis you should bring:


* A passion for building and owning mission\-critical systems. A growth mindset, with a willingness to mentor and learn in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment.
* A commitment and desire to effectively communicate and collaborate across teams and systems.
* An understanding of micro\-service encapsulation and loose coupling, and why they are important.
* An understanding of how to define technical and operational metrics to measure system health and to manage risk.
* A pragmatic approach to solving engineering challenges at scale.



Key Responsibilities:


* Design, build, and support scalable microservices and user interfaces for Disney’s Ad Platform, leveraging Java and modern front\-end frameworks.

* Mentor and support teammates through code reviews, documentation, and informal guidance (no direct reports).

* Strong background in relational databases (MySQL, Postgres), including schema and query design.


* Experience working with RESTful APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.


* Strong foundation in computer science principles, including data structures and algorithms.


* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications:


* Experience in ad tech.


* Experience with programmatic advertising or real\-time bidding platforms.


* Spring Boot and related Spring projects.


* Cloud platforms such as AWS.

* Data Streaming Mechanisms such as Apache Kafka, AWS Kinesis, and/or SNS/SQS. Required Education

  



Preferred Qualifications / Good to Have:

  


* BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

**Job Description**
-------------------


We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Engineer – AEM \& Forms to design, build, integrate, and support the experience layer of Agilent.com as part of a product\-oriented POD. Experience with HTL and AWS services is a plus.

--------------------------------------

Analyze complex datasets across multiple systems to identify risks and performance drivers, develop predictive frameworks for operational planning, and present actionable findings directly to Customer Success leadership.
* Operational Frameworks \& Process Optimization: Lead the design and improvement of operational reporting processes. Define standard operating procedures and best practices for reporting, data governance, and analytics while actively identifying opportunities to improve metrics, reporting automation, and data workflows.

---------------------------------

This includes building scalable reporting structures, exploring novel opportunities to leverage operational data, and implementing technical solutions that advance our operational maturity.
* Strategic Influence: You will exercise a high level of independent judgment to define metrics and reporting standards. Your findings and recommendations will directly influence strategic corporate decisions and determine how operational performance is evaluated across the enterprise.

----------------------------

* Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
* Field of Study: Operations, Analytics, Data Engineering, Management Information Systems, Finance, Economics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
* Experience: 5\+ years of experience in a Customer Success or Business Operations\-related analyst role, with a proven track record designing, developing, and maintaining high\-impact metrics, dashboards, and reports.

jobs.description:
**Job Title: Sales Manager – Vermilion**

**Company:** Zero Gravity Group \- Vermilion  
**Location:** Hyderabad  
**Experience:** 2–4 Years

**About Zero Gravity Group**

Zero Gravity Group is a rapidly growing business ecosystem specializing in photography, event services, wedding solutions, album designing, and creative branding. We are committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences through innovation, quality, and operational excellence.We are looking for a passionate and results\-driven **Sales Manager** with experience in the **event décor and event management industry** to drive business growth, manage client relationships, and oversee project coordination from inquiry to closure.

**Role Overview**

The Sales Manager will be responsible for generating and converting leads, managing client and vendor relationships, preparing quotations, negotiating pricing, and ensuring successful project execution. The ideal candidate should possess strong industry knowledge, excellent communication skills, and the ability to handle multiple stakeholders professionally.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Sales \& Business Development**

* Generate new business opportunities through **inbound and outbound sales activities**
* Conduct cold calls and follow\-ups to convert leads into confirmed bookings
* Meet sales targets and contribute to overall business growth
* Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing clients

**Client Relationship Management**

* Understand client requirements and provide suitable décor and event solutions
* Present proposals, quotations, and service offerings professionally
* Conduct client meetings and negotiations to close deals
* Ensure exceptional customer experience throughout the sales cycle

**Vendor Management \& Coordination**

* Coordinate with vendors for pricing, availability, and service requirements
* Maintain strong relationships with vendors and suppliers
* Negotiate pricing and service terms to achieve profitability while maintaining quality standards
* Resolve vendor\-related challenges efficiently and professionally

**Product \& Industry Knowledge**

* Possess a strong understanding of event décor materials, event setups, and industry trends
* Maintain knowledge of raw materials, costing, and vendor sourcing
* Provide recommendations and solutions based on client requirements and budget

**Reporting \& Administration**

* Maintain accurate records of leads, quotations, sales activities, and closures
* Prepare periodic sales reports and updates for management
* Ensure timely follow\-ups and documentation throughout the sales process

**Required Skills**

* 2–4 years of experience in **Event Management, Event Décor, Wedding Planning, or related industries**
* Strong experience in **cold calling, lead generation, and sales conversion**
* Good understanding of **event décor products, raw materials, and vendor networks**
* Excellent client handling and relationship management skills
* Strong negotiation and persuasion abilities
* Patience and professionalism in handling clients and vendors
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
* Proficiency in **MS Excel, MS Office, Google Sheets, and email communication**
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills

**Why Join Zero Gravity Group?**

* Opportunity to work with a fast\-growing and innovative organization
* Exposure to premium wedding and event projects
* Performance\-driven culture with growth opportunities
* Dynamic work environment with continuous learning and development
* Opportunity to build a long\-term career in sales and event management

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd.** 
 is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because
 **Good Health Can’t Wait.**




 We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.
   

  





 For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).
   

  





 ‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose\-driven, future\-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1\.5 Bn\+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency
   

  





 Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ \& nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

**Job Summary**
  

 We are looking for a Product Manager to develop, implement, and maintain long\-term strategies for high\-potential products in our current and future portfolio, aiming to maximize market share and profitability through strategic planning and execution.

This involves defining key success factors and requirements necessary for a successful product launch and owning the product strategy document.

 5\. You will ensure cross\-functional alignment on forecasts, product volume capacity requirements, and launch preparation, including recommendations for long\-term product\-specific capacity investments.
   

  





 6\. You will be accountable for the product's profit and loss (P\&L), including profitability calculation reflecting product\-specific sales and marketing costs and other investments before and after handing over to markets.
   

  





 7\. Your role includes defining and monitoring the life cycle management strategy with development teams and optimizing product allocation for products under supply constraints.
   

  

  

  





 8\. Your responsibilities extend to portfolio optimization and rationalization, involving commercial growth strategies, portfolio rationalization, and conducting in\-depth costing analysis and improvement strategies to enhance overall performance of the product.

 MBA
   

  

  

  

**Minimum work experience:** 
 5\-8 years of experience in similar Commercial, Program/Project Management or Strategy roles in Pharma or Lifesciences space

**Technical Skills**
  

 • Proficiency in managing and coordinating development projects from initiation to completion, including setting project goals, timelines, resource allocation, and risk management.
   

  

 • Experience in preparing for new product launches, including market analysis, competitor research, launch strategy development, and coordination with various departments to ensure successful market entry.
   

  

 • Expertise in overseeing the entire lifecycle of commercial products, including product planning, pricing, positioning, and promotion to maximize profitability and market share.
   

  

 • Experience in understanding market research, including market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities for strategic decision\-making.
   

  

 • Knowledge of market access strategies and marketing tactics to ensure products are accessible to target markets and effectively promoted to healthcare providers, payers, and patients.
   

  

 • Understanding of development and manufacturing supply value chain for Biosimilars or Biologics

jobs.title: Product Owner, IT [T500-28340]
jobs.description:
**ANSR is hiring for one of its clients.** 




**About American Airlines:** 




 To Care for People on Life's Journey®. Together with our American Eagle regional partners, we offer thousands of flights daily to more than 350 destinations in more than 60 countries.
 



 American Airlines is transforming the way it delivers technology to its customers and team members worldwide.
 



 American’s Tech Hub in Hyderabad, India, is our latest technology office location and home to team members who drive technical innovation and engineer unrivalled digital products to best serve American’s customers and team members. With U.S. tech hubs in Dallas\-Fort Worth, Texas and Phoenix, Arizona, our new team in Hyderabad, India enables better support of our 24/7 operation and positions American to deliver industry\-leading technology solutions that create a world\-class customer experience.
 



  





**INTRO:** 




 Are you ready to explore a world of possibilities, both at work and during your time off Join our American Airlines family, and you’ll travel the world, grow your expertise, and become the best version of you. As you embark on a new journey, you’ll tackle challenges with flexibility and grace, learning new skills and advancing your career while having the time of your life. Feel free to enrich both your personal and work life and hop onboard!
 



  





**WHY YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB:** 




 As part of the Contact Center Platforms team, you will strive to provide technology solutions that will help contact centers across American Airlines modernize the way they perform their day\-to\-day work. You'll develop relationships with stakeholders across the company as you define what problems they're looking to solve, find ways to use data to formulate a product strategy for delivering these solutions, and focus primarily on the user experience. If you enjoy mixing strategic and tactical skills to achieve outcomes, questioning the status quo, and delivering intuitive solutions that will exercise a user experience skillset, then this job is for you!
 



  





**WHAT YOU’LL DO:** 




 This list is intended to reflect the current job but there may be additional essential functions (and certainly non\-essential job functions) that are not referenced. Management will modify the job or require other tasks be performed whenever it is deemed appropriate to do so, observing, of course, any legal obligations including any collective bargaining obligations.
 


* Communicates regularly on OKRs, product roadmap, planned development, upcoming releases, and areas requiring leadership’s attention
* Coordinates with other Product team members to manage product dependencies and increments of value
* Performs continuous product discovery and offers valuable solutions that align to Product OKRs
* Understands the budgetary implications, related organizational constraints in factoring areas of focus
* Uses data to define baselines, measure outcomes, share insights, order backlog items, etc.
* Conducts competitive benchmarking, presents new technologies/solutions, identifies unmet/underserved need

**Description**
 Amazon's travel, events, and expense programmes serve employees at an unprecedented scale, with a mission to deliver an employee\-centric experience that lets them be more productive, while also helping to manage costs, safety, and sustainability. Today that experience is fragmented across too many systems, partners, and manual processes. We're hiring a Senior Product Manager \- Technical to own the product strategy that consolidates these into a unified platform, dramatically reducing cost\-to\-serve while delivering a self\-service experience employees prefer over the alternatives.
   

  

 You'll partner with engineering, science, and design teams alongside third\-party partners to deliver intelligent automation, personalized experiences, and modern customer service capabilities. AI\-powered intelligent personalization and automation are tools in your toolkit, not the job description itself. You should be energized by applying them to genuinely eliminate friction, not just modernize the wrapper around legacy processes. This requires someone who takes ownership of ambiguous problems, makes hard build\-vs\-buy calls, and delivers measurable results at pace.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define product requirements for self\-service capabilities that reduce support contacts, eliminate manual work, and cut expense processing time.
* Evaluate and apply emerging AI capabilities for knowledge orchestration, intelligent routing, and agentic automation, to deliver measurable product improvements.
* Collaborate with technical programme managers and engineering teams to translate product vision into high\-quality technical solutions
* Drive the product strategy for shifting from fragmented third\-party dependencies to first\-party platform ownership, informing build\-vs\-buy decisions that permanently restructure the cost base
* Lead and develop a team of product managers and analysts; hire bar\-raising talent
* Influence cross\-functional global teams across finance, HR, and workplace technology to resolve dependencies and deliver shared outcomes
* Partner with customer services teams to set new program\-level success metrics (adoption, cost\-to\-serve, customer satisfaction) and use data to drive prioritization
* Write compelling narratives, strategy documents, and business cases to contribute to executive alignment, investment, and cross\-organizational resourcing for transformation initiatives


 A day in the life
   

  

 Start with a backlog review with your team, sharpening acceptance criteria for a self\-service workflow that eliminates a manual handoff. Move to a design sprint with engineers where you're debating trade\-offs between two integration approaches and deciding which to prototype first. Progress with synthesizing customer feedback into a revised requirements doc, then pressure\-testing priorities with an existing third\-party partner. End the day with a quick check on adoption metrics from last month's release, turning what you learn into next sprint's input. You build first, then let the data tell you what to build next.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Amazon Travel \& Events exists to make every business trip and event seamless, safe, and cost\-effective for over 500,000 employees across 64 countries. Our Technology \& Data Solutions team is the builder behind that mission, designing the platforms and data capabilities that let employees plan, book, and manage travel and events and expense re\-imbursements with as little effort as possible. We partner across Amazon's enterprise to improve the employee experience, reduce programme costs, strengthen duty of care, and advance sustainability goals. We're a mix of builders, analysts, and domain experts united by one principle: make it easy.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* 7\+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Experience working with global teams and diverse partners


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior relative experience in corporate travel and events, expense management, or payments

jobs.description:
The Data Platform Product Owner is responsible for helping define, prioritize, and drive the evolution of the enterprise data platform as a product. The role will help ensure that the platform is designed to address business needs and is tailored to the organization structure and scale, while simultaneously being an advocate for data\-driven decision\-making and the enablement of the platform across the organization.
 



  





 Acting as the bridge between business domains, data platform teams, and engineering, the Product Owner translates business needs into clear platform requirements, defines priorities, and ensures delivery of capabilities that maximize business value. The role is accountable for maintaining a clear product vision, roadmap, and backlog for the platform, balancing strategic initiatives (e.g., data products, governance, marketplace, migration) with operational stability and efficiency.
 



  





 The Product Owner works closely with platform engineering, data architects, other Product Owners and DevOps teams to ensure that platform capabilities are delivered in a standardized, reusable, and scalable manner. They also collaborate with business stakeholders and product teams to define how the platform is consumed, ensuring clarity in delivery models, ownership, and support structures.
 



  





 A key responsibility of the role is to establish and enforce ways of working for the platform, including intake processes, prioritization frameworks, and governance standards. This includes ensuring that data product ownership, privacy\-by\-design, and compliance requirements are consistently embedded across all platform use cases.
 



  





 As a key figure in a global, organizational\-scale software initiative, the Data Platform Product Owner must be a promoter of the Agile mindset and a champion of continuous delivery and feedback, cooperating with the DevOps teams to implement practices that generate incremental and steady feature delivery at scale that adapts quickly to feedback and business changes.
 



 The role contributes to the continuous improvement of the platform by identifying gaps, driving enhancements, and aligning platform evolution with broader strategic initiatives such as data mesh adoption, data governance, and cloud transformation.
 



  





 Working closely with delivery leads, architects, and business product owners, the Data Platform Product Owner ensures a clear and transparent roadmap, enabling high\-quality, secure, and scalable solutions that support both current operations and future growth.
 



  





**Main Responsibilities** 




  





**Vision \& Product Strategy** 



* Define and maintain a clear product vision for the platform, balancing innovation, scalability, and operational stability.
* Own and manage the Data Platform product roadmap and backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic initiatives.
* Monitor platform adoption and usage, identifying gaps and driving continuous improvements.



  





**Stakeholder \& Business Engagement** 



* Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, data product teams, and platform engineering.
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements and priorities.
* Foster an understanding of product goals and vision. Ensure alignment on expectations, ownership, and delivery outcomes across stakeholders.



  





**Product Delivery \& Advocacy** 



* Lead and coordinate platform\-related initiatives end\-to\-end (e.g., data products, governance, marketplace, migration), ensuring delivery against agreed scope, timelines, and expected business outcome.
* Drive project management activities, including planning, tracking, risk management, and escalation handling.
* Champion the promotion of the platform across the business functions and advocate for its usage in upcoming analytics or data\-driven initiatives across domains.



  





**Operating Model \& Governance** 



* Define, implement, and continuously improve the platform operating model (delivery models, ownership, support).
* Establish and govern intake, prioritization, and demand management processes.
* Ensure transparency on capacity, trade\-offs, and prioritization decisions.



  





**Platform Standards \& Compliance** 



* Ensure adoption of platform standards, including data product frameworks, privacy\-by\-design, and governance requirements.
* Work with relevant teams to embed compliance and data ownership practices across all use cases.



  





**Collaboration with Engineering \& Architecture** 



* Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to ensure scalable, reusable, and maintainable platform capabilities.
* Align platform evolution with enterprise architecture and long\-term technology strategy
* Contribute to identifying and prioritizing technical improvements and platform enhancements.



  





**Communication \& Reporting** 



* Provide clear and consistent communication to stakeholders and leadership.
* Share roadmap updates, delivery progress, risks, and key decisions.
* Ensure transparency and alignment across all platform\-related initiatives.



  





 Other responsibilities / duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Product Owner II - eComms AI
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
 About the Role As a Product Owner on MCO’s eComms Compliance team, you will own the roadmap for a new scrum team dedicated to AI feature development across our communications surveillance and archiving solutions, which serve compliance professionals at global financial services firms including banks, broker\-dealers, hedge funds, insurance companies, and RIAs.
   

  

 This role will focus on AI\-powered capabilities—including AI\-based risk detection, message and conversation summarization, and AI\-assisted archive search—core to helping regulated institutions surface, investigate, and evidence communication risk at scale. You will be responsible for defining product requirements, prioritizing feature development, and working closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality software solutions in a fast\-paced SaaS environment.
   

  

 You’ll work at the intersection of regulatory needs and emerging AI capabilities, helping MCO deliver market\-leading tools that simplify complex compliance challenges.
   

  

**Job Requirements**
**Experiences and Skills:**
* 8 to 12 years of overall IT experience, including at least 5 years of proven experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or a similar role within SaaS\-based or enterprise B2B environments.
* Proven success managing features or products built on AI/ML capabilities—such as LLM\-based summarization, classification, risk scoring, semantic or vector search, or anomaly detection.
* Experience with compliance or regulatory technology and familiarity with financial services industries such as banking, broker\-dealers, hedge funds, insurance, or RIAs.
* Hands\-on experience working with data\-rich applications and large volumes of unstructured or sensitive data.
* Hands\-on experience shipping AI\-powered features using large language models (LLMs), natural language processing (NLP), retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), or other applied machine learning systems.
* Demonstrated ability to define and deliver features that drive data extraction, normalization, reporting, and advanced user insights.
* Comfortable translating complex business and technical needs into actionable user stories and product requirements.
* Track record of collaboration within globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.
* Strong communicator and cross\-functional collaborator, able to align stakeholders from engineering, compliance, design, support, and customer success.
* Proficient with agile tools and methodologies (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Scrum or Kanban practices).
* Bachelor’s degree required; a degree in business, computer science, engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.


**Responsibilities**
**Job Responsibilities**
* Own and manage the product backlog for AI\-driven features, including risk detection, message summarization, and AI\-assisted archive search.
* Translate high\-level customer and business needs into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with engineers, designers, QA, and other stakeholders to deliver high\-quality product increments.
* Drive product discovery and user research to deeply understand compliance professionals’ workflows and pain points.
* Define success criteria for AI features—precision, recall, false\-positive rates, and latency—and partner with data science and engineering to evaluate model performance before release.
* Work with Legal, Compliance, and Information Security to ensure responsible AI practices—data privacy, explainability, auditability, and human\-in\-the\-loop review—are built into each feature.
* Partner with stakeholders across Product, Sales, Customer Experience, and Support to prioritize roadmaps and ensure alignment.
* Act as the voice of the customer, advocating for usability, performance, and compliance use cases.
* Monitor industry trends, competitive offerings, and regulatory developments to inform product direction.
* Ensure releases meet quality and performance standards, and support go\-to\-market efforts with product documentation and enablement.
* Collaborate on metrics and reporting to assess product success and adoption.

jobs.title: Product Analyst
jobs.description:
**We are Creditspring, a new way of borrowing that focuses on its members and provides them with safe and efficient short\-term financial products.**


We're a fast\-growing FCA\-regulated consumer credit company. We have members, not customers and we take a lot of pride in that!


As one of the UK’s only subscription finance company in the market, we truly have a unique value proposition. Our mission is very clear; to improve the financial stability and resilience of our members. We do this through the products we provide, the partnerships we have, and our educational content. We want our members, and everyone in the UK to be able to better manage their finances and steer them away from high\-cost, unregulated credit options.


We’re a world\-class, well\-funded, diverse team from over 20 different countries that believes in the product we’re building and the service we’re providing for our members. We’ve grown significantly in the last 18 months and are evolving our Marketing structure to reflect that.

**About the role**


You’re the Product team’s first analyst, though not the company’s first. The Data \& Analytics team already own the pipelines, tables, and models beneath the product. Your job is to turn what’s in that data into decisions PMs can act on. Right now, nobody does that. You report to the CPO, who sets the strategic direction and clears the way with other teams. We’re hiring at the Senior level because the work needs it. Nobody has scoped this role before, which means you will. You’re the subject matter expert on product analytics here: you decide what questions matter, what data actually answers them, and what a healthy reporting rhythm looks like for this company. Your manager sets strategic direction and clears organisational blockers that need executive weight. Everything else (the analysis, the frameworks, the judgment calls) is yours.

**Responsibilities**

* **Be the Product team’s eyes:** Dig into user behavioural data and find out why, not just what happened. We have dashboards for everything, but they don’t always explain what’s behind the numbers. That’s your job. You’ll decide which questions are worth answering.
* **Connect Product and Data Engineering:** Data Engineering owns the pipelines, tables, and models. You’ll turn a PM’s question into a scoped, technical ask they can build against and make the case for why it matters when priorities compete. This relationship is yours to build and run.
* **Support the CPO directly:** Handle recurring insight and reporting requests, packaging insights for senior leaders clearly and using your own judgment.
* **Set the standard for how we measure success:** Decide how we track KPIs and maintain clean, reliable data. This won’t just be your own practice; it will become the standard that PMs, and eventually other analysts, are expected to follow.
* **Own where Product Analytics goes next:** This function doesn’t exist yet — you’re building it. Decide what to track next, what to retire, and what we should be measuring in six months that we aren’t today.
* **Own how we track product launches, before and after**: Be involved before a feature ships so the right tracking is in place from day one, rather than something that needs to be patched afterwards. Once it’s live, continue monitoring performance and build the habits and infrastructure needed to make this standard practice.
* **Reconcile data across platforms:** When Mixpanel, our product data, and our marketing data disagree, investigate and reconcile the differences. Flag issues when the solution requires more than Analytics can address alone.
* **Introduce better tooling:** Identify and implement better tools, including AI\-assisted analysis and workflows, wherever they can make us more efficient. You’ll have a Claude Enterprise licence from day one.

**What you'll need to succeed**

* 3–5 years’ experience in product or customer analytics, ideally working alongside Product or Data Engineering teams.
* Strong SQL and/or Python skills (or equivalent), with confidence working with large, complex, and messy production datasets.
* Experience with product or customer analytics tools, such as Mixpanel, Google Analytics (GA), Power BI, AB Tasty, or similar platforms.
* **Comfortable working with ambiguity:** Able to scope problems, make informed judgment calls, and course\-correct independently without waiting for someone else to provide the answer.
* **Good judgment around escalation**: Know when a blocker requires executive support and are confident raising it when necessary, while remaining comfortable operating autonomously day to day.
* **Able to influence without authority:** Build strong relationships across departments, understand what teams genuinely need, and communicate your recommendations in terms that resonate with different stakeholders.
* **Self\-starting and proactive:** Comfortable taking ownership and acting without waiting for permission or detailed direction.
* End\-to\-end analytics experience: Ideally, you’ve built or maintained dashboards and analyses from start to finish, even if you haven’t previously built an entire analytics function.
* Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate, automate, and improve your analytical workflows.
* Bonus: Previous experience within fintech, lending, financial services, or another regulated industry.  

  

Don’t meet all the listed requirements? Research shows that women and people of underrepresented groups often don't apply for jobs unless they're 100% qualified. As an equal opportunities employer, we know that diversity is a key part of our teams' successes \- so if your experience doesn’t fit perfectly but this role excites you, we’d love for you to apply. We’re committed to Creditspring being an inclusive environment where employees feel welcomed, valued and listened to; we want you to thrive as your true self.

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer II, UTR Tech
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on\-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on\-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on\-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.  

  

UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on\-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. As an SDE II on the UTR Tech team, you'll build and scale the systems powering Amazon's fastest delivery promises \- Same\-Day Delivery (SSD), Grocery, and Rush (1\-hr/3\-hr) programs across NA, EU, JP, and the Middle East. You'll own services spanning package injection, staging, sortation, and routing that keep millions of time\-critical orders on\-time, and directly move quality metrics like slot\-level DEA and defect BPS. This role blends deep technical ownership with high operational impact: your code runs in a live, sub\-hour delivery network where reliability and latency are non\-negotiable. You'll partner with product, science, and operations to launch new speed programs and expand grocery (including perishable/chill\-chain) into new regions. We're looking for an engineer who thrives on distributed\-systems challenges at scale and wants their work to be visible to customers the same day.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As an Engineer in the team, you will take part in in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large\-scale and complex software systems. You will get to leverage your experience and expertise to deliver innovative solutions to challenging problems. You will communicate your ideas effectively to achieve the right outcome for your team and customer. You enjoy collaborating with others to increase the effectiveness of the overall team. Your code, design, and implementation decisions should set a great example to other engineers. You will also have the opportunity to impact the technical decisions in the broader organization as well as mentor other engineers in the team.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**About Eloelo Group** 




 Eloelo Group is one of India's fastest\-growing consumer technology companies, building category\-defining products at the intersection of content, technology, and culture. The Group's flagship products —
 **Story TV** 
 in micro\-drama and
 **Master** 
 in micro\-learning — have together placed two Eloelo apps in India's Top 10, reaching over 100 million Indians who consume short\-form vertical content every day.
 



  





 Story TV is India's leading micro\-drama platform, with 10M\+ users and 500\+ original titles produced in partnership with studios like Balaji Telefilms and Applause Entertainment. Master is India's \#1 micro\-learning app, scaling to 5M\+ users in 50 days with 1,000\+ bite\-sized courses across AI, finance, English, and life skills.
 



  





 Role Overview
 



 As a Product Manager at Story TV, you will own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle for one or more key product areas — ranging from content discovery and recommendation systems to creator dashboards, live streaming experiences, or monetisation features. You will work at the intersection of user research, data, design, and engineering to build products that millions of viewers and creators love. This is a high\-ownership, high\-impact role for someone who is deeply user\-obsessed, data\-informed, and execution\-ready.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



  





**Product Strategy \& Roadmap** 



* Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for your designated product area in alignment with Story TV's business goals.
* Identify opportunities through user research, data analysis, competitive benchmarking, and stakeholder inputs.
* Prioritise features and initiatives using structured frameworks (RICE, ICE, MoSCoW) to maximise impact.



  





**Discovery \& User Research** 



* Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to deeply understand user needs, pain points, and behaviours.
* Synthesise insights into clear problem statements and translate them into well\-defined product requirements.
* Continuously validate assumptions through A/B testing, user interviews, usability testing, and analytics.



  





**Execution \& Delivery** 



* Write crisp PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that enable the engineering and design teams to build effectively.
* Partner with engineering leads to scope, plan, and deliver features on time with high quality.
* Own the sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release management processes for your pod.



  





**Data, Metrics \& Growth** 



* Define and track key product metrics (DAU/MAU, retention, watch time, engagement rate, conversion) and own performance dashboards.
* Use data to drive product decisions, identify growth levers, and course\-correct where needed.
* Drive experimentation culture — design, launch, and analyse A/B tests to optimise product experiences.



  





**Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Collaborate closely with Design, Engineering, Content, Marketing, and Business teams to deliver cohesive product experiences.
* Communicate product plans, progress, and results clearly to leadership and cross\-functional partners.
* Act as the voice of the user within the team and consistently advocate for user\-centric decisions.



 What We're Looking For
 



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications** 



* 5–7 years of product management experience, preferably in a consumer internet, OTT, media, or entertainment product.
* Strong analytical skills — comfortable working with SQL, product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Firebase, or similar), and deriving actionable insights from data.
* Experience writing detailed PRDs and working in agile development environments.
* Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and drive cross\-functional alignment.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills — ability to present complex ideas simply and persuasively.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to self\-manage and deliver in a fast\-paced environment.



  





**Good\-to\-Have** 



* Prior experience with video streaming platforms, OTT products, content recommendation systems, or creator economy tools.
* Exposure to personalisation, ML\-driven features, or recommendation algorithms is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with monetisation models — AVOD, SVOD, in\-app purchases, or creator revenue sharing.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; MBA from a premier institution is a plus.
* Experience working in a high\-growth startup environment.



  





 Traits That Will Make You Exceptional
 


* You are deeply curious about what users want and even more curious about why.
* You treat data as a compass, not a crutch — you know when to trust the numbers and when to trust your instincts.
* You are a strong communicator who can inspire a team around a vision and also get into the weeds with engineers when needed.
* You move fast without breaking things — you know how to ship iteratively and learn quickly.
* You are passionate about storytelling, content, and the future of entertainment in India.



  





 What We Offer
 


* An opportunity to shape the product experience of a rapidly growing digital entertainment platform.
* A collaborative, creative, and fast\-moving work environment with passionate colleagues.
* Competitive compensation, performance\-linked bonuses, and ESOPs.
* Direct access to leadership and a culture that values product thinking at every level.
* Significant career growth opportunities as Story TV scales its audience and product portfolio.



  





 How to Apply
 



 Excited about this opportunity? Send your resume along with a short note on a product you admire and why to our HR team. We'd love to understand how you think about products.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon strives to be Earth’s most customer\-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Retail Business Services (RBS) accelerates Amazon's growth by improving customer and Selling Partner (SP) experiences, while optimizing costs across Stores WW. RBS operates at the intersection of retail, operations, technology, and finance, ensuring Amazon’s systems and processes scale reliably while maintaining a high\-quality customer and selling\-partner experience.  

  

Returns Reduction as part of Cost to Serve (CtS) BU is a specialized program within RBS focused on driving down overall Return Rate for both Retail and FBA channels. Returns Reduction Program focuses on Upstream defect elimination with focus on defect identification and defect elimination and partners with System Owners, Category Teams, FC ACES, Finance, CS, and abuse\-related programs to uncover true drivers and remove them systematically. The team builds mechanisms that strengthen upstream defect visibility, and enable consistent governance and contributing directly to improved Free Cash Flow and scalable business growth.  

  

This role will focus on identification and prioritization of high\-impact defect opportunities and will own and define the roadmap for elimination of the problem space end to end. They will do this by building trusted partnerships with key stakeholders across technology, finance, operations and earning alignment to pursue defect elimination opportunities and influencing senior leaders through compelling, data\-driven business cases. This role requires an individual who is comfortable in diving deep into complex data sets and presenting strategic recommendations to leadership up to three tiers above level. The candidate will bring strong business and supply chain acumen, a bias for action, and the strategic vision by directly contributing to improved cost to serve performance and driving scalable growth across Amazon Stores worldwide.  

  

Why You’ll Love This Role  

* Customer Impact: You’ll lead critical projects that remove defects, improves customer experience and directly influence Amazon’s supply chain cost, driving measurable results.
* Strategic Influence: Collaborate across global teams, including technology, finance, operations to shape strategies that focuses on improving customer satisfaction.
* Data\-Driven Innovation: Leverage analytics to uncover insights and optimize supply chain performance.

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Deliver Results, Dive Deep: Conduct deep\-dive analysis on customer returns data to identify and quantify top defect opportunities. Own execution of elimination initiatives end\-to\-end, escalating blockers and partnering with senior team members on prioritization.
* Ability to Influence: Build data\-driven business cases for defect elimination opportunities and present recommendations to managers and cross\-functional partners, using insights to influence team\-level priorities and tradeoffs.
* Earn Trust: Build strong working relationships with immediate stakeholder groups; proactively communicate progress, risks, and findings to gain alignment on defect elimination priorities within your scope.
* Financial Collaboration: Work closely with finance partners to quantify returns impact, validate savings estimates, and ensure proposed initiatives align with the team's financial targets. Identify tradeoffs between near\-term cost reduction and longer\-term goals, surfacing recommendations to leadership.
* Stakeholder Communication: Coordinate stakeholder updates across project milestones, process changes, and escalations within your assigned programs, ensuring timely and clear communication. Provide analytical support to leaders on strategy documents, research requests, and data pulls as needed.

  

A day in the life  

Defect Opportunity Identification: Leverage analytics tools and customer anecdotes to identify high\-impact defect opportunities within the Returns space. Conduct root cause analysis to validate findings and develop use cases, applying judgment to prioritize based on customer impact, value, and feasibility of solutions.  

  

* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with cross\-functional teams across system\-owning orgs, finance, operations, and supply chain to drive alignment on solution implementation. Proactively flag blockers, coordinate dependencies, and support delivery timelines within assigned programs.

  

* Leadership Communication: Communicate effectively with managers and senior stakeholders, presenting data\-driven insights and recommendations to inform decision\-making. Trusted to present findings and proposals to leaders one to two tiers above level, supporting alignment on program priorities

The RBS is an integral part of Amazon online product lifecycle and buying operations. RBS Return reduction team functioning under CX\-Business unit. The primary responsibility of the RBS return reduction team is to reduce returns that result in negative consumer experiences. This includes identifying the causes of returns and collaborating with the appropriate teams to eliminate defects. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Introduction**
 Plotline helps consumer apps create personalized in\-app and off\-app experiences without repeated engineering effort.
   

  

 We are looking for a Product Manager to own key product modules end\-to\-end. This is a
 **1\-to\-n product role** 
 focused on improving, scaling, and driving adoption of existing and new capabilities.
   

  

 You will work directly with customers, designers, engineers, Customer Success, and founders to decide what to build, ship it, and ensure customers receive measurable value from it.
   

  

****What You Will Own****
* Own the roadmap for assigned in\-app and off\-app modules
* Speak regularly with customers and participate in QBRs
* Identify recurring customer problems and convert them into scalable product improvements
* Benchmark Plotline against competitors and close important product gaps
* Define requirements and problem statements for design and engineering
* Drive features from prioritization through launch, adoption, and iteration
* Measure whether shipped features improve customer value
* Help establish Plotline as an innovative, AI\-first, class\-leading product


****What Success Looks Like****
**First 3 Months**
* Develop a strong understanding of Plotline’s customers, products, and competitive landscape
* Build relationships with 5 to 6 customers and independently run product conversations
* Establish adoption and value metrics for assigned modules
* Identify and prioritize the most important product gaps
* Own at least one meaningful product improvement from problem definition to launch


**First Year**
* Get each assigned module adopted by at least five paying customers
* Improve adoption and meaningful usage after launch
* Deliver improvements that solve recurring problems across multiple customers
* Keep Plotline competitive with leading customer\-engagement platforms
* Build a clear, evidence\-based roadmap with explicit trade\-offs
* Demonstrate measurable improvements in customer value, retention, or expansion


**Responsibilities**
**Product Ownership**
* Own assigned modules from roadmap through adoption and continuous improvement
* Prioritize customer problems using customer evidence, usage data, commercial impact, competitive context, and engineering effort
* Make clear decisions about what to build, what to delay, and what not to build
* Define the smallest valuable version and reduce unnecessary scope


**Customer Insight**
* Speak regularly with customers and independently lead product discussions
* Participate in QBRs and understand how customers use Plotline
* Synthesize customer interviews, support issues, usage data, and commercial feedback
* Separate recurring product problems from one\-off feature requests
* Validate whether shipped solutions have resolved the original problem


**Competitive Benchmarking**
* Regularly evaluate competing products and emerging market trends
* Identify capabilities where Plotline must match or lead the market
* Translate competitive findings into practical product decisions
* Help ensure Plotline is perceived as innovative and AI\-first


**Product Delivery**
* Give designers clear problems, user context, constraints, and desired outcomes
* Partner closely with engineering on feasibility, trade\-offs, edge cases, and delivery
* Maintain clear scope, requirements, success metrics, and non\-goals
* Resolve ambiguity and unblock decisions during development
* Coordinate launches with Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and Support


**Adoption and Outcomes**
* Define success metrics before development begins
* Create rollout, enablement, and adoption plans for every major launch
* Track customer adoption, repeat usage, customer value, and retention signals
* Investigate why valuable features are not being adopted
* Improve, reposition, or stop investing based on evidence


****What we are looking for****
* 3 to 6 years of product management experience in B2B SaaS or a comparable technology product
* Proven ownership of products or modules from prioritization through adoption
* Evidence of shipping and scaling features across multiple paying customers
* Strong examples of measurable adoption, usage, retention, or business impact
* Experience making prioritization decisions under limited engineering capacity
* Ability to independently run customer conversations
* Strong product judgment and customer empathy
* Experience working closely with product designers and engineers
* Comfort understanding APIs, SDKs, integrations, data flows, and analytics
* Strong written and verbal communication


****Strong Signals****
* You can explain what you personally decided, shipped, and improved
* You have taken a feature from low adoption to meaningful customer usage
* You have rejected attractive requests to protect a more important outcome
* You can identify patterns across conflicting customer feedback
* You benchmark competitors without blindly copying them
* You define success through customer outcomes, not launches
* You continue owning a product after it ships


****What This Role Is Not****
* It is not primarily a GTM, sales, or pipeline\-generation role
* It is not a project\-management or ticket\-writing role
* It is not limited to launching new features
* It is not a pure 0\-to\-1 discovery role
* It is not about building custom solutions for every customer


****Why Join Plotline?****
* Own strategically important products used by consumer businesses globally
* Work directly with customers, founders, designers, and engineers
* Shape the roadmap across in\-app engagement, off\-app communication, analytics, gamification, and AI
* See your work move from customer problem to shipped product and measurable adoption
* Operate with meaningful autonomy and clear outcome ownership


 If you enjoy understanding customers, making difficult product decisions, shipping with strong teams, and ensuring products create real value after launch, we would love to hear from you.

**Overview**
 At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.
   

  

 Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.
   

  

 You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward\-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.
   

  

 Come make an impact every day at Zebra.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
 In this rapidly evolving world, Zebra Technologies is always looking for new ways to disrupt the status quo, go to market faster, and optimize customer experiences. We are seeking an experienced, high\-caliber Advanced Product Owner to help lead this mission. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the success of a project in Scrum. The product owner is responsible for managing and optimizing the product backlog in order to maximize the value of the product and ensure product vision is met. We need someone who has an entrepreneurial mindset for distilling business value and goals into roadmaps and refined product backlogs. Most important, we need a product owner who can help us build better products that people love to use.
   

  

**Objectives of this role**
* Lead team scrums to define product vision, roadmap, and growth opportunities, effectively communicating with stakeholders throughout the development lifecycle.
* Develop a deep understanding of Zebra's products, competitive landscape, and customer needs to align the product roadmap with strategic business goals.
* Work closely with product managers and business teams to create and maintain the product backlog according to business value, ROI, and customer impact.
* Act as a highly collaborative bridge between engineering teams and business stakeholders, ensuring seamless alignment on requirements, timelines, and technical constraints.
* Stay ahead of market trends, emerging technologies, and Agile/Scrum best practices to continually elevate team velocity and product quality.


**Responsibilities**
* Serve as the communication link between the customer, product manager, and development team. Be the ultimate embodiment of and advocate for the customer's voice inside the development team.
* Assess value, develop cases, and prioritize stories, epics, and themes to ensure work aligns with product strategy.
* Build and set production process priorities to ensure the development team focuses on high\-impact items.
* Work closely with development teams to oversee new product development, validating that development is exactly on spec and mitigating roadblocks to achieve sprint/release goals.
* Drive innovation by identifying and leveraging emerging technologies (including AI and machine learning) to create competitive differentiation in our product offerings.
* Actively participate in all team meetings with internal stakeholders to ensure the development process follows the ratified product roadmap.
* Provide constructive feedback to Product Managers to continuously refine this roadmap.
* Serve as a product ambassador internally and externally, sharing knowledge, answering questions, and supporting product launches by providing a comprehensive understanding of the value proposition.
* Mentor and guide junior team members and peers, sharing Agile best practices, industry knowledge, and product expertise.


**Required Skills And Qualifications**
* 10 \+ years of experience in product development, product ownership, or a closely related field.
* Deep expertise in Agile methodologies and frameworks and tools, including extensive experience operating within Scrum.
* Practical experience utilizing AI\-driven tools to accelerate and improve effeciency.
* Outstanding communication, presentation, and leadership skills.
* Ability to effectively manage conflicting needs of stakeholders and maintain strong business acumen and customer orientation.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to make data\-driven decisions that balance customer needs with business goals.


**Preferred Skills And Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent work experience) in a related discipline; Advanced Degree is a plus.
* Proficiency with applicable project management tools and technology


**Benefits**
 We understand the importance of work\-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well\-being day to promote revitalization and success.
   

  

**Job Posting Statement**
 To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e\-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.
   

  

**AI Technology Statement**
 Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job\-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people.
