jobs.description:
**About BiteSpeed**




  





 Hey there! We are a
 **Sequoia\-backed SaaS startup** 
 building an AI\-native Marketing, Support \& Sales suite for
 **e\-commerce brands.** 




  





 We're currently working with
 **3000\+ e\-commerce brands** 
 globally across 50\+ countries and are fortunate to have
 **raised $5\.5M\+** 
 along the journey with marquee investors like Sequoia Capital India, Kunal Shah, Gaurav Munjal \& more backing us.
 



  





 💡
 **Read more about our mission and the story of commerce here!** 




  





**Check out more about us here** 
 \- https://www.bitespeed.co/ and do read through our 200\+ odd 5\-star reviews to get a sense of what our customers say about us (we openly brag about this 😉).
 



  





 We've had some solid investors back us (making it easier for you to stalk us since you'd do this anyway).
 



  





**About the Role**




  





 Enterprise customers rarely come to us with neatly packaged problems. They come with a business goal, a messy process, a bunch of systems that don't talk to each other and a question:
 **"Can AI solve this?"** 




  





 We’re looking for an
 **AI Product Manager** 
 who can sit with our enterprise customers, understand these problems deeply and turn them into
 **AI\-powered solutions** 
 . You’ll operate at the intersection of strategy, technology, operations and customer conversations, working closely with our product and engineering teams to take solutions from an idea to something that actually works.
 



  





 This isn't a traditional PM role where you'll spend your days writing PRDs and moving tickets around. You'll be expected to get into the weeds, understand how things work, figure out what can be automated or solved with AI, and work backwards from the business outcome. You’ll have a front\-row seat to some of the most interesting AI use cases emerging in commerce.
 



  





**What you'll do**



* Work directly with
 **enterprise customers** 
 to understand their business processes, pain points and goals, and identify opportunities where AI can create meaningful impact.



  




* Translate ambiguous business problems into
 **AI\-led solution strategies** 
 , figuring out what should be automated, augmented or redesigned.



  




* Own the solutioning process from
 **problem discovery to implementation** 
 , working closely with engineering, product and customer\-facing teams.



  




* Design workflows and solutions using
 **LLMs, AI agents, automation and BiteSpeed's product capabilities** 
 to solve real customer problems.



  




* Work with enterprise stakeholders to build business cases, define success metrics and communicate the expected impact of proposed solutions.



  




* Get hands\-on with the details when required, whether that's understanding APIs, data flows, system architecture or experimenting with AI tools and prototypes.



  




* Identify patterns across customer problems and feed those insights back into the
 **product roadmap** 
 , helping us decide what should become a scalable product rather than a one\-off solution.



  




* Build repeatable
 **solutioning playbooks, processes and operating mechanisms** 
 that help us solve enterprise problems faster as we scale.



  




* Partner with Sales and Customer Success on strategic accounts, helping them win, onboard and grow enterprise customers through better technical and AI\-led solutioning.



  




* Stay close to the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem and continuously experiment with new models, tools and approaches that could unlock better solutions for our customers.



  





**What makes you a good fit**




  




* You enjoy sitting with a messy problem and figuring out
 **"how would we actually solve this?"** 
 rather than waiting for someone to hand you a requirements document.



  




* You have a
 **strong technical foundation** 
 and are comfortable understanding APIs, integrations, data flows and software systems. You don't necessarily need to be a full\-time engineer, but you should be technical enough to go deep when the problem demands it.



  




* You have
 **3\+ years of experience** 
 in product, solutions engineering, consulting, technology, strategy \& operations or a similar role where you've solved complex business problems.



  




* You are genuinely curious about
 **AI and LLMs** 
 and have experimented with AI tools, agents, workflows or applications beyond simply using ChatGPT to write emails.



  




* You are comfortable speaking to
 **enterprise customers and senior stakeholders** 
 , understanding their problems and explaining technical solutions in simple business language.



  




* You have strong business judgment and can distinguish between a problem that needs a fancy AI solution and one that just needs a better process.



  




* You are comfortable operating with
 **ambiguity and high ownership** 
 . There won't always be a playbook, and that's kind of the point.



  




* You care about outcomes more than job titles and enjoy moving between strategy, customer conversations and getting your hands dirty with execution.



  





**Salary and Location**




  





**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



  





**Expected CTC:** 
 We pay top of market for the right folks and also offer generous equity (ESOP) to everyone in the team
 



  





**Our Way Of Life**
 \- https://www.notion.so/bitespeed/Way\-Of\-Life\-At\-BiteSpeed\-44d9b9614d9641419da910189b1e9f8e.
 



  





**Our Purpose**




  





 At BiteSpeed, work is personal. You could blame this on us being existential, but most of us are spending the best years of our lives doing this and we want to be purposeful about the kind of workplace we’re trying to create.
 



  





**Our purpose is about why we’re here and what we care about:\-** 




  




* Personal Transformation
* Wealth Creation
* Winning Together



  





**Our Values**

jobs.title: SAP Business Analyst-FICO
jobs.description:
**Your Job**
We are seeking an experienced **Finance Business Analyst** with strong expertise in SAP Finance to support and enhance enterprise finance solutions across **SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, and Central Finance (CFIN)** platforms. In this role, you will partner with Finance stakeholders, technical teams, and enterprise architects to deliver scalable finance solutions, drive process improvements, support business\-critical operations, and contribute to global finance transformation initiatives.


This position requires a blend of functional SAP FICO expertise, business analysis capabilities, production support experience, and a passion for enabling business value through technology.
  

**Our Team**


You will join a collaborative team focused on delivering and supporting enterprise finance capabilities across a global organization. Working closely with Finance leaders, Application Management Services (AMS), Enterprise Architecture, and technology delivery teams, you will help drive finance transformation, standardization, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across a complex SAP ecosystem.
  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Partner with Finance stakeholders to support and enhance business processes across Record\-to\-Report (R2R), Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), Order\-to\-Cash (O2C), Treasury, and Controlling functions.
* Design, configure, and optimize SAP Finance solutions across SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, and Central Finance environments to deliver business value and operational efficiency.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable, supportable, and standardized SAP Finance solutions.
* Support global finance transformation programs, system enhancements, upgrades, and rollout initiatives across multiple regions and business units.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless integration between SAP and enterprise applications supporting procurement, treasury, banking, tax, and financial operations.
* Drive issue resolution, root\-cause analysis, and continuous improvement efforts to ensure stability and effectiveness of finance applications.
* Support financial compliance, audit readiness, period\-end close processes, reporting accuracy, and governance requirements.
* Promote SAP best practices, Clean Core principles, finance process standardization, and adoption of SAP S/4HANA innovations and analytics capabilities.
* Contribute to testing, solution validation, deployment activities, and post\-go\-live support to ensure successful project delivery and business adoption.
* Build strong partnerships across business and technology teams to continuously improve user experience and enterprise finance capabilities.

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**  

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related discipline.
* 8\+ years of experience supporting, implementing, or enhancing SAP Finance solutions.
* Hands\-on experience configuring and supporting SAP FICO in both SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Strong functional knowledge of General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Asset Accounting (AA), Banking, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, CO\-PA/Margin Analysis, and Intercompany Accounting.
* Experience gathering business requirements, performing functional analysis, configuring solutions, supporting testing activities, and providing production support.
* Experience troubleshooting integrated business processes and collaborating with technical teams across SAP and non\-SAP applications.
* Experience working within an IT service management environment supporting incidents, service requests, and operational support activities.
* Proven ability to work effectively with global business stakeholders and cross\-functional teams.

**What Will Put You Ahead**  

* Experience supporting or implementing SAP Central Finance (CFIN).
* Experience with SAP Group Reporting, Financial Consolidation, Intercompany Elimination, and Embedded Analytics capabilities.
* Knowledge of Universal Journal (ACDOCA), Material Ledger, Actual Costing, and SAP S/4HANA Finance innovations.
* Experience with third\-party finance applications such as BlackLine, Coupa, ONESOURCE, Kyriba, or GetPaid and related SAP integrations.
* Experience supporting global SAP rollouts, finance transformations, S/4HANA migrations, or complex multi\-system landscapes.
* Familiarity with SAP Fiori finance applications, Clean Core principles, and SAP standardization practices.
* Experience working within an AMS support model and using ServiceNow for incident and change management.
* SAP Finance or SAP S/4HANA\-related certifications.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
About the Role
 



 GoComet is one of the fastest\-growing AI\-powered supply chain platforms globally. Founded by four IITians in 2016, backed by $25M\+ in funding, and serving over 500 enterprise brands — including names like Unilever, Sun Pharma, Glenmark, and Lupin — we help the world's largest businesses run their global supply chains smarter.
 



 We're hiring a Senior Business Analyst to join the team that shapes how our enterprise clients get the most out of our platform — and influences how the product evolves based on what those clients actually need. The role sits at the intersection of consulting, product, and implementation, and is one of the highest\-leverage seats in the company.
 



  





 Key Details
 


* **Location:** 
 J P Nagar,Bangalore
* **Experience:** 
 4–6 years
* **Reports to:** 
 Lead BSA / Head of Implementation
* **Travel:** 
 Occasional, for high\-value client engagement



  





 What You'll Actually Do
 


* Work alongside our Customer Success team and our enterprise clients to understand each client's as\-is processes — their current workflows, pain points, and operational chaos — and design the to\-be process on the GoComet platform.
* Identify the right solution for each custom requirement (what's a clean fit, what's not, what can be standardized) and author Product Requirement Documents that engineering can build against cleanly.
* Drive the custom development lifecycle end\-to\-end — coordinating across engineering, QA, and Product through scoping, build, UAT, and go\-live — and spot patterns across clients that shape the core product roadmap.
* Solve real problems in supply chain tech with the Unilevers, Schneider Electrics, Sun Pharmas, and Tatas of the world — learn real\-world challenges by talking directly to customers and lead the solution to those challenges.



  





 Who We're Looking For
 



 You probably have:
 


* 4–6 years in one or more of: business analysis, implementation consulting, solutions consulting, professional services, technical product management, or management consulting.
* A track record of taking complex, ambiguous business problems and turning them into structured, buildable solutions.
* Strong analytical depth — you can decompose a messy process, spot edge cases others miss, and reason through trade\-offs clearly.
* Comfort working alongside both client\-facing teams (CS) and engineering teams — able to translate between business and tech language fluently.
* Curiosity about supply chain, logistics, or enterprise operations (you don't need prior domain expertise — you do need to find the problem space interesting).



  





 Bonus, not required:
 


* Exposure to SaaS implementation, API\-based integrations, or workflow automation.
* Background in engineering, supply chain, or operations.
* Experience working with global enterprise clients across time zones.
* An MBA — useful, not required.



  





 Why GoComet?
 



 Enterprises Exposure
 



 You will get to work directly with Unilevers, Hondas and Tatas of the world and create direct impact.
 



 Pure Meritocracy
 



 At GoComet, growth is fueled by impact, not tenure. We operate a high\-performance environment where your promotion and rewards are directly tied to the value you create.
 



 Global Footprint
 



 You will design solutions for an international stage, working with diverse teams and clients across the globe, from New York to Singapore.
 



 True Ownership
 



 You are the "CEO" of the solution you design. Your decisions directly impact the supply chains of global giants.
 



 Elite Growth
 



 We are a high\-growth Series A company where performance is rewarded with rapid leadership opportunities.
 



 Complexity at Scale
 



 Solve the multi\-trillion\-dollar problem of global logistics fragmentation using AI and automation.
 



 Inclusive Excellence
 



 We are committed to diversity and equal opportunity. We believe that solving global problems requires a team that reflects the world's diversity, bringing together unique perspectives to drive innovation.
 



 Culture of Excellence
 



 We hire for mindset and character. You'll work alongside a team that values experimentation, transparency, and high\-velocity learning.

jobs.title: ServiceNow Business System Analyst
jobs.description:
We’re in an unbelievably exciting area of tech and are fundamentally reshaping the data storage industry. Here, you lead with innovative thinking, grow along with us, and join the smartest team in the industry.
   

  

 This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 As a ServiceNow Business System Analyst at Everpure™, you will serve as the strategic bridge between cross\-functional business partners and technical engineering teams to unlock the full potential of our enterprise platform. You will maximize organizational agility by aligning ServiceNow capabilities across ITSM, HR, and Field Services directly with key business outcomes. Partnering closely with developers, product owners, and enterprise leaders, you will drive operational efficiency, seamless automation, and platform modernization. If you thrive on transforming complex enterprise workflows into scalable, high\-impact digital experiences, this role offers an exciting opportunity to shape our technology ecosystem.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Drive Business Process Optimization \& Alignment: Lead workshops with key stakeholders across IT, HR, and Operations to map current\-state workflows, eliminate operational bottlenecks, and design scalable future\-state processes that enhance service efficiency and align with enterprise governance standards.
* Manage Agile Backlog \& Deliver Strategic Value: Transform complex business requirements into prioritized epics, clear user stories, and acceptance criteria within Agile delivery frameworks, ensuring technical features directly support measurable organizational goals.
* Ensure Delivery Excellence \& Solution Quality: Partner with platform architects and engineering teams to review system designs, define testing strategies, and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to guarantee seamless, defect\-free deployments.
* Accelerate Adoption \& Drive Continuous Improvement: Lead change management initiatives, design end\-user training materials, and analyze post\-implementation metrics to maximize platform adoption, improve data quality, and identify continuous enhancement opportunities.


**What You Bring**
* ServiceNow \& Enterprise Platform Expertise: 4\+ years of hands\-on experience as a Business System Analyst configuring and optimizing core ServiceNow modules (such as ITSM, HRSD, CSM, or SPM) and integrating them across enterprise cloud systems.
* Agile Requirements \& Workflow Design: Proven track record in eliciting requirements, writing user stories with defined acceptance criteria, and modeling complex end\-to\-end business process flows in Scrum or SAFe environments.
* Stakeholder Facilitation \& Problem Solving: Strong facilitation and analytical skills, with a proven ability to manage competing business priorities, simplify technical solutions for non\-technical partners, and influence decisions across functions.
* Service Framework Knowledge: Deep understanding of ITIL, ITSM, or CSDM frameworks and how to leverage out\-of\-the\-box platform capabilities prior to custom development.
* Location \& Work Environment: We are primarily an in\-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.


**What You Can Expect From Us**
* Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
* Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
* Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.


 And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company\-sponsored team events. Check out purebenefits.com for more information.
   

  

**Accommodations And Accessibility**
 Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA\-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.
   

  

**Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team**
 We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.
   

  

 Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.
   

  

**Join us and bring your best.**
**Bring your bold.**
**Pure and simple.**
